purpose: Bind Documentation Truth and default test-discovery proof to the provider-resolved live pull-request target branch so stale webhook base snapshots cannot fabricate unrelated candidate drift or launder a stale proof baseline.

claims: `.github/workflows/documentation-truth.yml` must resolve the live pull-request target from `base.ref`, reject invalid or non-ancestor live bases, and must never use `pull_request.base.sha` as current documentation-proof authority.

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` must bind both Documentation Truth and default test-discovery baselines to the provider-resolved live target ref, fail closed when that base is invalid or not an ancestor, and never treat the pull-request event base snapshot as current proof authority.

`README.md` must state that pull-request proof baselines use the live target ref at execution time and that stale event base snapshots cannot become current Documentation Truth or test-discovery authority.
`docs/FOUNDER_MERGE_AUTHORITY.md` must require live target-branch proof baselines for Documentation Truth and test discovery and fail closed when the exact candidate has not incorporated that base.
`GLOBAL_AI.md` must require agents to treat `pull_request.base.sha` as event-snapshot evidence only and resolve the live target ref before load-bearing proof.
`.ai/skills/juss-flow-launch-loop/SKILL.md` must bind Documentation Truth and test-discovery proof to the live target-ref baseline and reject stale or non-ancestor baselines before merge review.

`src/lib/__tests__/liveProofBaseResolution.contract.test.ts` must reject reintroduction of `pull_request.base.sha` and require live-ref resolution, exact SHA validation, fetch, and ancestor checks for the load-bearing proof consumers.
